mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the next 20 days signals monetary easing, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS declines, or in non-easing regimes.

mechanism_narrative: A crossing of GDPC1 above 17,000 in the next month predicts rising demand, driving up corporate earnings and S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not positive when GDPC1 crosses above 17000, or no significant correlation (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in INDPRO (supply) and decline in FEDFUNDS over 60 days signals balanced supply-demand dynamics, enhancing market confidence and returns.
failure_condition: No significant positive returns (p>0.05) when INDPRO rises and FEDFUNDS falls, or if the joint effect is not statistically distinct from baseline.

mechanism_narrative: UNRATE exceeding 4.5% in the next 5 days indicates labor market tightness, raising inflation expectations and compressing returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns not negative when UNRATE crosses above 4.5%, or no significant negative correlation (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a 'monetary tightening cycle', FEDFUNDS above 4% predicts higher interest rates, reducing equity valuations and negative returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS >4% but SPX 20d returns not negative, or in tightening regime with no significant negative correlation (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising HOUST (demand) alongside falling FEDFUNDS over 5 days signals accommodative policy and demand expansion, driving positive returns.
failure_condition: No positive returns (p>0.05) when HOUST rises and FEDFUNDS falls, or if the interaction effect is not statistically significant.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in INDPRO over 60 days reflects robust supply growth, boosting corporate profits and S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO rising but SPX 60d returns not positive, or no significant positive correlation (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: PAYEMS crossing above 145,000 in the next month signals strong labor demand, potentially driving up wages and inflation, leading to negative returns.
failure_condition: PAYEMS crosses above 145000 but SPX 20d returns not negative, or no significant negative correlation (p>0.05).
